item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud lha mo 'od zer zhi ba'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag gi lo zla'i tshes nyin par ka ke'u nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas rig ldan karma mu tra bde ldan mas grogs mdzad cing khrom gter du bgyis shing / slar zla tshes la bsod nams can gyi 'byor ba'i mi dbang sa skyongs chen po'i pho brang rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse la/ shog ser bod yig tu phab grub pa bgyis so//
